title: Detergents & Surfactants — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Detergents & Surfactants Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) for the product.
gtin.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

countryOfManufacture.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the product was manufactured.

ingredientSubstanceName.title: Substance Name
ingredientSubstanceName.description: Chemical name of the ingredient substance.

ingredientIupacName.title: IUPAC Name
ingredientIupacName.description: IUPAC systematic chemical name of the substance.
ingredientIupacName.x-citationNote: CLP governs how a substance is IDENTIFIED on the label and in classification, through the Art. 18(3) product identifier rules — a name, not an amount. It creates no duty to publish an IUPAC name as product data; the label and the safety data sheet are the channels through which composition information reaches users.

ingredientCasNumber.title: CAS Number
ingredientCasNumber.description: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number for the ingredient.

ingredientEcNumber.title: EC Number
ingredientEcNumber.description: European Community number (EINECS/ELINCS) for the substance.

ingredientReachRegistrationNumber.title: REACH Registration Number
ingredientReachRegistrationNumber.description: REACH registration number assigned by ECHA.
ingredientReachRegistrationNumber.x-citationNote: A REACH registration number is assigned to the registrant and appears in section 1 of the safety data sheet supplied down the chain under Art. 31. REACH creates no duty to publish it as product data, and for a mixture it is the constituent substances that carry registrations, not the product.

preservatives.title: Preservatives
preservatives.description: Array of preservatives with substance name and CAS number.
preservatives.x-citationNote: Preservatives reach consumers through the CLP label and, where applicable, sector labelling rules; CLP itself creates no separate duty to publish a preservative list as product data. Its labelling duty is discharged by what is affixed to the package.

fragranceAllergens.title: Fragrance Allergens
fragranceAllergens.description: Array of fragrance allergens present above threshold, with CAS numbers.
fragranceAllergens.x-citationNote: Fragrance allergen disclosure is a LABELLING duty in the sector instruments that impose it, not a CLP one — CLP's own obligation is the hazard label. Publishing the list here is useful to allergic users but is not how the duty is discharged.

hazardClass.title: Hazard Classes
hazardClass.description: Array of CLP/GHS hazard classifications applicable to the product.

hazardPictograms.title: Hazard Pictograms
hazardPictograms.description: Array of GHS pictogram codes applicable to the product (GHS01 through GHS09).

hazardStatements.title: Hazard Statements
hazardStatements.description: Array of H-code hazard statements with full text.

precautionaryStatements.title: Precautionary Statements
precautionaryStatements.description: Array of P-code precautionary statements with full text.

supplementalHazardInfo.title: Supplemental Hazard Information
supplementalHazardInfo.x-citationNote: CLP Annex II covers supplemental label information — EUH statements and similar. The obligation is to place that text ON THE LABEL; a passport copy repeats it rather than discharging it.

ufi.title: Unique Formula Identifier (UFI)
ufi.description: 16-character alphanumeric code linking the product to its poison centre notification. Required for hazardous mixtures.

poisonCentreNotificationNumber.title: Poison Centre Notification Number
poisonCentreNotificationNumber.description: Notification number from ECHA poison centres notification portal.
poisonCentreNotificationNumber.x-citationNote: CLP Annex VIII governs notification of hazardous mixtures to the bodies appointed under Art. 45 for emergency health response. The duty is discharged by NOTIFYING those bodies — a database entry — and the resulting UFI belongs on the label. Publishing the notification reference in a passport neither creates nor satisfies the obligation.

emergencyPhoneNumber.title: Emergency Phone Number
emergencyPhoneNumber.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for chemical incidents.

productCategoryEuPCS.title: EU Product Categorisation System (EuPCS)
productCategoryEuPCS.description: Product category code under the European Product Categorisation System for poison centre notifications.

svhcSubstances.title: SVHC / Substances of Concern
svhcSubstances.description: Array of Substances of Very High Concern present in the product above 0.1% w/w.

svhcSubstanceName.title: SVHC Substance Name
svhcSubstanceName.description: Name of the substance of very high concern.

svhcCasNumber.title: SVHC CAS Number
svhcCasNumber.description: CAS registry number for the SVHC substance.

svhcEcNumber.title: SVHC EC Number
svhcEcNumber.description: EC number for the SVHC substance.
svhcEcNumber.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 33 is the SVHC communication duty and it is narrower than it looks: to business recipients, and to consumers ON REQUEST within 45 days, for articles containing an SVHC above 0.1% w/w, with a minimum content of the substance NAME. Publishing an EC number proactively exceeds what any in-force provision requires.

svhcConcentrationRange.title: SVHC Concentration Range
svhcConcentrationRange.description: Concentration range of the SVHC in the product.

svhcLocationInProduct.title: SVHC Location in Product
svhcLocationInProduct.description: Where in the product the SVHC substance is present.
svhcLocationInProduct.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

svhcSafeUseInstructions.title: SVHC Safe Use Instructions
svhcSafeUseInstructions.description: Instructions for safe use regarding the SVHC substance.

svhcCandidateListDate.title: SVHC Candidate List Date
svhcCandidateListDate.description: Date when the substance was added to the ECHA SVHC candidate list.
svhcCandidateListDate.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 59 governs how a substance is added to the candidate list. The date of inclusion determines when the Art. 33 communication and SCIP notification duties bite for that substance; it is a fact about the list rather than a datum the manufacturer is required to publish.

svhcScipNotificationId.title: SCIP Notification ID
svhcScipNotificationId.description: SCIP database notification identifier from ECHA for articles containing SVHCs.
svhcScipNotificationId.x-citationNote: The SCIP database notification is required by Waste Framework Directive Art. 9(1)(i), in force since 5 January 2021, for articles containing candidate-list substances above 0.1% w/w. The duty is discharged by notifying ECHA — a database entry — not by publishing the resulting identifier.

appearance.description: Physical appearance of the product (colour, form).

density.title: Density

viscosity.title: Viscosity

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Array of ingredients/substances in the product, each with name, identifiers, concentration and function.
ingredients.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part A point (h) makes a FULL LIST of intentionally added substances, identified per CLP Art. 18(3), genuine passport content — one of the nine Part A points. Note the inversion against the label: the passport carries the full list but no amounts, while Annex V Part A carries banded concentrations for a narrower set. Applies from 23 Sep 2029.

ingredientInciName.title: INCI Name
ingredientInciName.description: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients name, where applicable.
ingredientInciName.x-citationNote: An INCI name is a cosmetics naming convention. Under Reg (EU) 2026/405 the passport identifies substances per CLP Art. 18(3) (Annex VI Part A point (h)), not by INCI, so this is a convenience field rather than a mandated one.

ingredientConcentrationRangePercent.title: Concentration Range (%)
ingredientConcentrationRangePercent.description: Weight percentage concentration range of the ingredient in the product.

ingredientFunctionCategory.title: Functional Category
ingredientFunctionCategory.description: Functional classification of the ingredient in the formulation.
ingredientFunctionCategory.x-citationNote: Functional categories such as surfactant or enzyme are an Annex V Part A LABELLING construct. Annex VI Part A — the passport dataset — asks for a list of intentionally added substances, not a functional breakdown. Applies from 23 Sep 2029 and lands on the label.

surfactantsTotal.title: Total Surfactants (%)
surfactantsTotal.description: Total weight percentage of all surfactants in the product.
surfactantsTotal.x-citationNote: Banded ingredient content is an Annex V Part A LABEL obligation. There is no concentration or percentage anywhere in Annex VI Part A, so a total-surfactant figure discharges the labelling duty, not the passport one.

phosphatesContent.title: Phosphates Content (% P2O5)
phosphatesContent.description: Total phosphorus content expressed as P2O5 percentage.
phosphatesContent.x-citationNote: A banded content figure under Annex V Part A, which is the LABEL. The Annex VI Part A passport dataset carries no amounts.

phosphonatesContent.title: Phosphonates Content (%)
phosphonatesContent.description: Total phosphonate content as weight percentage.
phosphonatesContent.x-citationNote: A banded content figure under Annex V Part A, which is the LABEL. The Annex VI Part A passport dataset carries no amounts.

edtaContent.title: EDTA Content
edtaContent.description: Content of EDTA and its salts (chelating agent) as weight percentage.
edtaContent.x-citationNote: A banded content figure under Annex V Part A, which is the LABEL. The Annex VI Part A passport dataset carries no amounts.

soapContent.title: Soap Content
soapContent.description: Weight percentage of soap (fatty acid salts) in the formulation.
soapContent.x-citationNote: A banded content figure under Annex V Part A, which is the LABEL. The Annex VI Part A passport dataset carries no amounts.

opticalBrighteners.title: Optical Brighteners Present
opticalBrighteners.description: Whether the product contains optical brighteners / fluorescent whitening agents.
opticalBrighteners.x-citationNote: Optical brightener disclosure is an Annex V Part A labelling item under Reg (EU) 2026/405, applying from 23 Sep 2029. It is not among the nine Annex VI Part A passport points.

enzymes.title: Enzymes
enzymes.description: Array of enzyme types used in the product (e.g. protease, lipase, amylase, cellulase).
enzymes.x-citationNote: Enzymes appear as an Annex V Part A labelling category. The passport's own duty is the Annex VI Part A point (h) list of intentionally added substances; a separate enzyme field is label-shaped, not passport-shaped.

microorganisms.title: Microorganisms
microorganisms.description: Array of microorganisms used in the product, with species and strain identifiers. Conditional — required only if product contains added microorganisms.
microorganisms.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part A point (i) requires all intentionally added micro-organisms with their taxonomic classification — genus, species, and strain name or code. Genuine passport content under Reg (EU) 2026/405, applying from 23 Sep 2029.

ultimateBiodegradation.title: Ultimate Biodegradation
ultimateBiodegradation.description: Whether the surfactants in the product achieve ultimate aerobic biodegradation.
ultimateBiodegradation.x-citationNote: Surfactant biodegradability is a market-placement CONDITION — a surfactant must meet the ultimate-biodegradation criterion to be placed on the market, with the test evidence held in the technical documentation. Passing is the duty; publishing the result is not among the Annex VI Part A passport points.

biodegradationTestMethod.title: Biodegradation Test Method
biodegradationTestMethod.description: Standard test method used for biodegradation assessment (e.g. OECD 301B, OECD 310).
biodegradationTestMethod.x-citationNote: The test method underpins the biodegradability evidence held in the technical documentation. It is not an Annex VI Part A passport point and not label content.

degradationPercent.title: Degradation Percentage
degradationPercent.description: Percentage of biodegradation achieved in the standard test.
degradationPercent.x-citationNote: The measured degradation figure is evidence supporting the biodegradability condition, held in the technical documentation rather than published. Annex VI Part A carries no percentages.

passThreshold.title: Pass Threshold Met
passThreshold.description: Whether the product meets the minimum biodegradation pass threshold (typically >=60%).
passThreshold.x-citationNote: The pass threshold is a property of the test criterion, not of the product. It is neither Annex V Part A label content nor an Annex VI Part A passport point.

recommendedDoseMl.title: Recommended Dose (mL)
recommendedDoseMl.description: Recommended dosage in millilitres for a standard use cycle.
recommendedDoseMl.x-citationNote: Dosage instructions are Annex V Part A LABEL content for consumer laundry detergents, expressed for the reference conditions the annex sets. The passport dataset in Annex VI Part A does not include dosage.

waterHardnessRange.title: Water Hardness Range
waterHardnessRange.description: Water hardness range for which the recommended dose applies (soft/medium/hard).
waterHardnessRange.x-citationNote: Water hardness is a reference condition for the Annex V Part A dosage statement on the LABEL, not an Annex VI Part A passport point.

machineLoadsPerPackage.title: Machine Loads per Package
machineLoadsPerPackage.description: Number of standard machine loads achievable from one package.
machineLoadsPerPackage.x-citationNote: The number of standard machine loads per package is an Annex V Part A LABEL statement for consumer laundry detergents. It is not passport content under Annex VI Part A.

usageInstructionsText.title: Usage Instructions
usageInstructionsText.description: Detailed usage instructions for the product.
usageInstructionsText.x-citationNote: Annex V Part A point 1(e) requires 'instructions for use and special precautions, where necessary and relevant' in the label content. Verified against the EUR-Lex text; the previous 'ESPR, SDS Section 7' article cited a framework that mandates no fields.

intendedUse.title: Intended Use
intendedUse.description: Description of the product's intended use and application scope.

issuedUnderSoleResponsibility.title: Issued Under Manufacturer's Sole Responsibility
issuedUnderSoleResponsibility.description: Confirms the digital product passport is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer (Reg (EU) 2026/405 Annex VI Part A(e)). Set automatically on creation.
issuedUnderSoleResponsibility.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part A point (e) requires the passport to state that it is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer. Genuine passport content, applying from 23 Sep 2029.

complianceDemonstrated.title: Compliance Demonstrated
complianceDemonstrated.description: Confirms compliance of the detergent or end-user surfactant with Reg (EU) 2026/405 has been demonstrated (Annex VI Part A(g)). Set automatically on creation; reference other Union law complied with in the declaration of conformity.
complianceDemonstrated.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part A point (g) requires a statement that compliance has been demonstrated, with references to the other Union law complied with. Genuine passport content, applying from 23 Sep 2029.
